title: The Three Dwellings: Stripping the Archons of Water, Darkness, and Fire
description: How three "dwellings of deceit" (water, darkness, fire — corrupted truth, falsity-from-evil, and the burning of self-love) were drawn out from the archons. The Living Spirit as wise physician applies three medicines, dons three pure garments (wind/water/fire as perception/truth/love), and pours out the corrupt three. Twelve great works of the resulting cosmic economy bind them in encircling strongholds within the Wall of Great Fire; three Words of Life keep watch.
